parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: Tennessine, $\text{Ts}$, is an unstable man-made element. It is found below astatine, $\text{At}$, in Group 17. The chemical properties of $\text{Ts}$ and its compounds have only been predicted.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Suggest an equation for the reaction of $\text{NaTs}$ and $\text{Br}_2$. Assume that $\text{Ts}$ follows the same trends as the other elements in Group 17. Explain your answer.
